security_comparison.documented: MD5(email + date + time) — described in java-design.asciidoc and confirmed in swagger POST /booking summary as correct behavior
security_comparison.actual: MD5(email + date + time) — same, but code-assessor identified this as a CRITICAL security vulnerability (JAVA-001): MD5 is cryptographically broken and the token is predictable from known email + approximate timestamp
security_comparison.discrepancy: Documentation describes the implementation accurately but COMPLETELY FAILS to document the security risk. The Swagger spec even documents the MD5 formula without any security caveat.
security_comparison.recommendation: Add security risk warning to all locations that describe token generation. Add SecureRandom alternative to SECURITY.md.

security_comparison.actual: BaseUserDetailsService has a mutable instance field 'private UserEntity user' on a Spring singleton, creating a race condition under concurrent requests — JAVA-002 (code-assessor-report.md)
security_comparison.discrepancy: Complete absence — zero documentation of this vulnerability
security_comparison.recommendation: Document in SECURITY.md with fix recommendation (convert to local variable)
